post.instagram_caption:
The Dow jumped 1,569 points on Wednesday, November 4, the day after the US midterm elections.

The Dow rose about 3% to close at 53,356, AP reports. The S&P 500 rose 1.6% to 7,688.62, its best day in three months, and the Nasdaq rose 1.4%. Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate, and President Trump said he would accept the results; analysts told CNBC that markets tend to prefer gridlock. Brent crude fell 8.7% to $94.62, its lowest level in two months, as energy traders appeared to bet on less uncertainty from the Iran war, TheStreet reports. Energy stocks fell the most, and AI data center stocks slipped on fears of new limits. Figures as of the November 4, 2026 close.
